detail.longDescription: I want to run OpenCode within a sandbox and use Claude Code enterprise credentials (not API key)! The usual way that this works with OpenCode outside of the sandbox is that I use the [opencode-claude-auth]( https://github.com/griffinmartin/opencode-claude-auth ) plugin to load the claude credentials after I sign into Claude with /login . The credentials are then stored in ~/.claude/.credentials.json I believe and loaded by the OpenCode plugin. Now what's the recommended way to do this in a docker sandbox? Ideally once I create the sandbox it's ready to use and I don't have to do any additional setup work within the container.
